evidence_refs.quote: Founded in May 2019, Robust.AI operates in the extremely popular — and wildly competitive — warehouse space.
At Robust.AI, we build AI-powered collaborative mobile robots designed to work alongside people in dynamic warehouse environments.
Carter — an autonomous warehouse cart — is paired with Grace, Robust’s software offering.
While they can navigate autonomously or follow workers around after a quick setup, human employees can also grab the handles and move them around manually, as needed.
